name: justshipai
description: Practical tools for AI product managers, starting with eval design.

plugins.name: evals-coach
plugins.description: A guided seven-step wizard that turns a feature description into a runnable eval: criteria, test cases, graders, judge prompts and a release gate, handed back as an eval plan, test-cases.csv and judge prompts. Built for product managers.

plugins.name: no-surprises
plugins.description: Protects your decision rights during substantial Claude Code implementation. Reinforces a Go/Log/Gate policy on every prompt and pauses with a native AskUserQuestion before consequential product, architecture, data, authorisation, privacy, security, cost or external-provider commitments.
